# KaizenReply — Complete Reference

> **Your message is good. Make it better.**
> KaizenReply (https://kaizenreply.us.ci) is a free, open-source AI writing studio, reply generator, and **Reality vs LinkedIn meme generator** built on Japanese Kaizen (改善) and 5S principles.

## Why KaizenReply Is Unique
1. **Kaizen Philosophy ("Don't rewrite. Improve.")**: Small, deliberate edits beat destructive overhauls. KaizenReply preserves your facts, names, dates, and authentic voice instead of replacing your message with generic prose.
2. **5S Applied to Communication**:
   - **Seiri (整理 · Sort)**: Cuts fluff, hedges, and filler.
   - **Seiton (整頓 · Set)**: Organizes thoughts around clear intent.
   - **Seiso (清掃 · Shine)**: Polishes tone and removes grammatical noise.
   - **Seiketsu (清潔 · Standardize)**: Keeps your personal voice consistent.
   - **Shitsuke (躾 · Sustain)**: Explains every change in Marginalia so your writing improves over time.
3. **Free & Open Source (No Paywall, No Login)**: Includes a full **Reality vs LinkedIn Meme Generator** at zero cost, whereas most competing LinkedIn meme tools are paid or watermarked.

---

## Free Reality vs LinkedIn Meme Generator

### How to Generate a LinkedIn Meme in the UI
1. Open [https://kaizenreply.us.ci/#desk](https://kaizenreply.us.ci/#desk).
2. Type any mundane reality into **Your Draft** (for example: `"I overslept and skipped the gym"` or `"I ate a sandwich at 2 PM"`).
3. Select the **LinkedIn Bro** tone chip (under All or Punchy).
4. Press **Refine Draft**. Your exact typed text is preserved on the **Reality** side, while the AI generates corporate thought-leadership satire for the **LinkedIn** side.
5. Click **Meme Card** in the result toolbar to preview, download (2048×1364 PNG), or share the Reality vs LinkedIn comparison card.

### Supported LinkedIn Satire Formats
- `Auto` (selects the sharpest comedic contrast)
- `Reality vs LinkedIn` (side-by-side mundane truth vs executive framing)
- `One-line corporate translation`
- `The LinkedIn announcement`
- `Fake professional profile`
- `Developer edition`

---

## Core Writing & Reply Capabilities

### Message Refinement (`POST /api/improve`)
Improves clarity, tone, and impact while preserving facts, names, dates, and intent.
- **Tones (21)**: Professional, Friendly, Concise, Casual, Polite, Formal, Persuasive, Assertive, Diplomatic, Warm, Empathetic, Confident, Fix Grammar Only, LinkedIn Bro, Cold Email Hook, Dating App Opener, ELI5, Passive-Aggressive, Tech Twitter Thread, Roast My Draft, Gen Z.
- **Platforms (9)**: Email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, X (Twitter) (<=280 chars), SMS (<=160 chars), Slack, Discord, Instagram, Telegram.
- **Output**:
  - `improved`: refined message
  - `score`: `before` (0–100), `after` (0–100), and breakdown (`clarity`, `tone`, `professionalism`, `readability`)
  - `notes`: list of `{ original, replacement, reason }`

### Reply Mode (`POST /api/reply`)
Generates 3 distinct, ready-to-send replies to an incoming message, tailored by tone, platform, recipient, and optional conversation context.

### Tone & Platform Analyzer (`POST /api/analyze`)
Analyzes a draft to detect its current tone and recommend the best target tone and platform.

### Meme Render API (`POST /api/meme/generate` & `GET /api/meme/demo`)
- `POST /api/meme/generate` accepts `{ "reality": "...", "linkedin": "..." }` and returns a 2048×1364 JPEG comparison card rendered with Pillow and Noto Serif.
- `GET /api/meme/demo` returns a cached sample Reality vs LinkedIn meme image.

### Kotowaza Proverbs (`GET /api/quotes`)
Returns traditional Japanese proverbs with Kanji, Hiragana, Romaji, literal translation, English meaning, JLPT level, and usage examples. Supports `?limit=1..200` and `?tag=...`.

---

## Tech Stack & Open Source
- **Backend**: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, httpx, Pillow
- **Frontend**: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript (no build step), Service Worker PWA
